title: DataSubjectRight
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — data subject rights under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Articles 15-22 define individual rights that data subjects can exercise against controllers. Each right has specific conditions, exemptions, and response obligations. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Articles 15-22.

rightType.description: The data subject right being exercised. ACCESS: obtain confirmation and copy of personal data (Art 15). RECTIFICATION: correct inaccurate data without undue delay (Art 16). ERASURE: obtain erasure ('right to be forgotten') when grounds apply (Art 17). RESTRICTION: obtain restriction of processing in specific circumstances (Art 18). PORTABILITY: receive data in structured, machine-readable format and transmit to another controller (Art 20). OBJECTION: object to processing based on public interest or legitimate interests (Art 21). AUTOMATED_DECISION_PROTECTION: not be subject to solely automated decision-making with legal/significant effects (Art 22).

requestReceived.description: Whether a request to exercise this right has been received from the data subject.

identityVerified.description: Whether the identity of the data subject making the request has been verified. Controller may request additional information to confirm identity. Source: GDPR Art 12(6).

responseProvided.description: Whether the controller has provided a response to the data subject's request.

responseTimeDays.description: Number of days from receipt of request to response. Standard deadline: 30 days, extendable by 60 days for complex/numerous requests. Source: GDPR Art 12(3).

exemptionApplied.description: Whether an exemption to the right was applied (e.g., Art 17(3) exemptions to erasure, Art 21(1) compelling legitimate grounds for objection override).

exemptionBasis.description: Legal basis for any exemption applied. References the specific GDPR article/paragraph providing the exemption grounds.

dataCopyProvided.description: Whether a copy of the personal data undergoing processing has been provided to the data subject. Applicable when rightType is ACCESS. Source: GDPR Art 15(3).

dataRectified.description: Whether inaccurate personal data has been rectified or incomplete data completed without undue delay. Applicable when rightType is RECTIFICATION. Source: GDPR Art 16.

dataErased.description: Whether personal data has been erased without undue delay where grounds apply. Applicable when rightType is ERASURE. Source: GDPR Art 17(1).

processingRestricted.description: Whether processing has been restricted in accordance with the data subject's request. Applicable when rightType is RESTRICTION. Source: GDPR Art 18(1).

dataProvidedInStructuredFormat.description: Whether personal data has been provided in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format. Applicable when rightType is PORTABILITY. Source: GDPR Art 20(1).

directTransferCompleted.description: Whether personal data has been transmitted directly from one controller to another, where technically feasible. Applicable when rightType is PORTABILITY. Source: GDPR Art 20(2).

processingCeased.description: Whether the controller has ceased processing the personal data following the data subject's objection, unless compelling legitimate grounds override. Applicable when rightType is OBJECTION. Source: GDPR Art 21(1).

humanInterventionProvided.description: Whether human intervention has been provided on the part of the controller, including the right to express a point of view and contest the decision. Applicable when rightType is AUTOMATED_DECISION_PROTECTION. Source: GDPR Art 22(3).
